scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Water Conservation/Environment Compliance (WCS)
other_conditions: The business/organization must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise
The business/organization must belong to the manufacturing sector
The business/organization should be in the private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or be a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs
Production must have started on or after 1st April 2019
The Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must be between 1st April 2020 and 31st March 2025
The application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or within 12 months from the date of notification of Banglashree, whichever is later
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 50% of expenses for a captive effluent water treatment plant or other pollution control devices, with a maximum limit of ₹2,00,000 per enterprise.
